prompt: Create an original 120 second Indian acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for coding, deep work and analytical tasks. Mood: focused, steady, precise. Instruments: sitar, bansuri, tabla, tanpura. Style: gradually unfolding modal melody and intricate tabla. Tempo approximately 90 BPM; A minor. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Keep a stable repeating texture with very few distracting fills. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: A melodic piece featuring traditional Indian instrumentation, including sitar, flute, and tabla. It has a serene and meditative quality, building slightly in complexity and energy.
description.zh: 一首旋律优美的作品，以印度传统乐器为主，包括西塔琴、长笛和塔布拉鼓。它具有宁静和冥想的特质，在复杂性和能量上略有提升。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
